title: v5.3.0 — Streak Auto-Claim & Polish
message: Daily streak popup removed — bonus chips are now claimed automatically with a toast notification instead of a blocking popup. New 'Hide Tap to Resume' toggle in Gameplay settings (separate from Reduce Motion). Account and profile panels now fill edge-to-edge including the status bar and gesture bar areas. All icon references updated to high-resolution 512px. Full account panel rework from v5.2.9 included.
